scope.methodLimit: Findings distinguish visible/audible content from author assertions. No external corroboration was performed.

overallVerdict.summary: The video visibly contains digital-host/live-commerce examples, human-plus-digital composited live layouts, product-detail shots and a two-person in-store fashion/demo sequence. It does not independently prove lip-to-speech synchronization, deployment scale, GMV, vendor attribution, commercial availability, brand case-study performance, or that the walking participant is the digital human.

visualGroundTruth.topic: digital-human live commerce exists in the edit
visualGroundTruth.finding: The edit shows vertical live-commerce interfaces and several human-like presenters labeled or contextually presented as JD digital humans.
visualGroundTruth.limit: Frames alone do not establish how the presenters were generated, whether they were live, or who supplied the underlying technology.

visualGroundTruth.finding: Mouth shapes visibly change across the showcased presenter clips.
visualGroundTruth.limit: The source is a creator-narrated edit rather than an isolated avatar audio/video test. The relevant avatar utterance, exact phonemes, latency and original unedited clip are unavailable, so 'completely synchronized' or 'natural synchronization' cannot be verified.

visualGroundTruth.finding: A live-commerce layout shows two presenter-like figures together, and the slide labels the mode as dual-person/interactive co-broadcast.
visualGroundTruth.limit: The video does not independently identify which figure is digital versus real, prove simultaneous live generation, or exclude prerecorded/composited playback.

visualGroundTruth.finding: The edit shows an ANTA-branded jacket, close-up garment details, shoe-store background, prices/promotional banners, comments and a product card; other presenter clips also use live-commerce UI.
visualGroundTruth.limit: Visibility of a sales interface does not prove sales conversion, autonomous product knowledge, real-time operation or who authored the sales copy.

visualGroundTruth.finding: The footage shows a two-person in-store fashion/demo layout and bodily movement by the taller participant, followed by garment close-ups.
visualGroundTruth.limit: The participants are not explicitly identified. The visible walking/model movement cannot be confidently assigned to the digital human; the claim that the digital human itself walks a runway is therefore unverified.

visualGroundTruth.finding: The creator appears at an event/exhibition area with JD/JD Cloud-related signage and demonstrations.
visualGroundTruth.limit: The supplied files do not provide event credentials, date or independent proof of the exact conference identity.

authorClaims.claim: More than 10,000 brands use these digital humans.
authorClaims.support: The number appears only in the creator narration/burned caption over venue display footage; no readable report, methodology, time window or denominator is provided.
authorClaims.requiredCorroboration: Dated primary JD source defining active brand, product scope and counting method.

authorClaims.claim: Annual merchandise sales exceed RMB 14 billion.
authorClaims.support: No independently readable sales report or period definition appears in the supplied evidence.
authorClaims.requiredCorroboration: Dated audited/official primary source specifying gross versus net GMV, period, attribution rules, cancellations and returns.

authorClaims.claim: ANTA created a digital-human live room in an offline flagship store and the digital human handles product, discount and styling information.
authorClaims.support: An ANTA-branded in-store live-commerce scene and garment/product UI are visible.
authorClaims.missing: Store identity/location, official ANTA authorization, participant identity, system provider, live status and degree of automation are not established.

authorClaims.claim: Balabala built nearly ten live rooms using digital humans.
authorClaims.support: The edit shows Balabala-related desktop/live content but no countable set of approximately ten rooms or primary deployment record.
authorClaims.requiredCorroboration: Official deployment list with dates, store/account identifiers and operational definition of a live room.

authorClaims.claim: Digital-human live commerce accounts for as much as 15% of total GMV.
authorClaims.support: The percentage is present in narration/burned captions but no source table, period, brand denominator, channel scope or attribution method is shown.
authorClaims.requiredCorroboration: Primary brand/JD data defining numerator, denominator, reporting period, returns/cancellations and causal attribution.

authorClaims.claim: All showcased technology is based on JD Digital Human.
authorClaims.support: JD Digital Human branding is visible at the exhibition and on later demo clips.
authorClaims.missing: No technical provenance links each brand case or every displayed component to JD.

authorClaims.claim: For 618, JD launched an industry-first batch of highly commercially usable digital humans.
authorClaims.support: The on-video caption states '高商业可用数字人' and presents avatar archetypes.
authorClaims.missing: No launch date, comparison set, definition of 'industry first', production SLA, licensing terms, availability terms or adoption evidence is supplied.

authorClaims.claim: The customized voices are emotional, lack an AI feel, generate scenario-specific sales scripts readily and can quickly make products popular.
authorClaims.support: Presenter clips and changing mouth/gesture frames are visible.
authorClaims.missing: No isolated audio, comparative evaluation, prompt/output trace, conversion experiment or causal sales evidence is provided.

conflictsAndAmbiguities.srt: 行业首批高盛宴可用的数字人
conflictsAndAmbiguities.burnedCaption: 行业首批高商业可用数字人
conflictsAndAmbiguities.resolution: Use '高商业可用数字人' as the intended wording. Treat the SRT phrase '高盛宴可用' as an ASR/transcription error, not as source truth.

conflictsAndAmbiguities.finding: The two figures in co-broadcast/runway examples are not explicitly labeled as real versus digital in a way that can be independently verified.
conflictsAndAmbiguities.impact: Do not claim which person is the digital human or that the digital human performs the walking action without a primary source.

conflictsAndAmbiguities.finding: Avatar images and presenter clips are shown without names, capture/model origin, likeness authorization, voice authorization or synthetic-media disclosure terms.
conflictsAndAmbiguities.impact: The footage cannot establish commercial reuse rights or whether the depicted identities are licensed, fictional, staff, models or generated composites.

conflictsAndAmbiguities.finding: '高商业可用' is a marketing-quality assertion, not proof of general availability or a license grant.
conflictsAndAmbiguities.impact: Do not interpret it as 'commercially free to use' or as clearance for third-party reuse.

strengths: Complete 83-second source video and provided subtitles are present
Evidence pack covers 29 detected shots, all 21 subtitle cues and 57 dense probes
Dense 1.5-second sampling is sufficient to locate major visual categories and most scene transitions
limits: The evidence pack contains frames and transcript mapping, not original provenance documents

The creator edit may crop, subtitle, composite and reorder underlying materials

Downgrade lip-sync, co-broadcast and runway statements to 'the demo shows/claims' unless original unedited demonstrations are obtained.
Cite primary dated sources for all scale, sales, GMV, deployment and industry-first claims.
